subject: Rate card + competitor pricing comps — Vertex Retail evaluation
messages:
From: Luke Henderson <luke.henderson@vertexretail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@vertexretail.com
Date: 2026-10-18T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask: hosted API rate card + competitor match

Hi Karthik,

We're finalizing the evaluation for our customer-facing personalization API and need a clear hosted rate card from Redwood. Our procurement team also asked whether you can match or come close to the public pricing and committed tiers we received from OpenAI, Anthropic and Together — they submitted a short summary (attached).

Key asks:
- Baseline per-token rates for text-generation (context + output) at 1M / 10M / 50M monthly tokens
- Any committed-usage discounts or credits for 12-months
- Whether caching/prefix savings can be represented in an ROI example
- Typical SLA for hosted API and any credits tied to latency SLOs

We're hoping to land this before the exec procurement review on Oct 22. Can you send a baseline + one “stretch” price that would be acceptable to Redwood for a first-year contract?

Thanks,
Luke
Head of Platform Engineering
Vertex Retail
[attachment: vertex_competitor_quotes.pdf (PDF)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Luke Henderson <luke.henderson@vertexretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: hosted API rate card + competitor match

Hi Luke — thanks for the note and the attachments. We're excited about the evaluation. I'm looping in Marissa and Rachel on pricing and procurement coordination.

We'll put together:
- A clear hosted API rate card at the tiers you requested (1M / 10M / 50M tokens)
- A committed-usage discount option for a 12-mo agreement (three tiered discounts)
- A short ROI example showing expected savings from prefix/KV caching + Redwood Optimize recommendations (that typically reduces token spend 10–25% depending on workload)
- SLA summary and commercial credits policy

One quick question for the ROI calc: is the 50M token number the steady-state monthly level or a peak you expect for product launch? If it's steady-state we can show deeper discounting.

I'll aim to send a first draft by COB Monday (Oct 19).

Best,
Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

[attachment: vertex_requirements.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Quick ask: hosted API rate card + competitor match

Karthik / Rachel — quick internal take before we reply to Vertex:

1) Competitor context (our understanding):
- OpenAI: public list with volume tiers; they tend to offer ~10–15% for first-year commits to strategic pilots.
- Anthropic: can be price-competitive on chat-like workloads; commit discounts around 12–18% depending on region and model.
- Together: marketplace + credits can make effective unit-cost lower on front-loaded deals.

2) Our levers to be competitive:
- Offer a 12-mo committed tier at 10% / 18% / 24% for 1M / 10M / 50M baseline respectively (example) — but we need director sign-off for 24% at 50M.
- Include a quantified caching/Optimize uplift example (e.g., 18% effective token reduction for their personalization use case).
- Add a one-time onboarding credit (e.g., $10k) or free access to Redwood Optimize for 90 days to sweeten the first year.

3) Margin ask: Rachel, can you confirm E2E margin at 50M with 24% discount + $10k credit? If unacceptable we propose 20% limit and include Optimize instead of credit.

Marissa
Head of Strategic Accounts

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Luke Henderson <luke.henderson@vertexretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood hosted rate card + proposal (draft)

Luke — attached is a concise draft proposal and baseline rate card. Summary below: 

Baseline hosted rates (text generation, per 1k input+output tokens):
- 1M monthly: $0.030 / 1k tokens (baseline)
- 10M monthly: $0.025 / 1k tokens ( +10% commit discount sample )
- 50M monthly: $0.018 / 1k tokens (stretch tier with commit)

12-month committed options (first-year effective off list):
- 1M commit: 10% off baseline
- 10M commit: 18% off baseline
- 50M commit: 22% off baseline (final approval pending leadership but we can hold this as an authorized offer through Oct 22)

Additional commercial items: 
- One-time onboarding credit: $10,000 applied to first invoice OR 90-day complimentary Redwood Optimize access (we recommend Optimize since it demonstrably reduces token spend).
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for hosted API; latency SLOs vary by model/region with service credits for repeated breaches (details in attached).
- ROI: based on your shared workload, we estimate caching + Optimize could reduce billable tokens 12–20% depending on personalization prefix reuse (sample calc in proposal).

Attachments: redwood_proposal_v1.pdf — includes detailed tier math and sample savings table.

If this looks directionally right I can prepare final commercial terms and a 1-page mutual action plan for DocuSign.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_proposal_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Luke Henderson <luke.henderson@vertexretail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@vertexretail.com
Date: 2026-10-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood hosted rate card + proposal (draft)

Karthik — thanks, the numbers are helpful and align with what we'd hoped to see. Procurement is comfortable moving forward with the 50M commit at the 22% first-year discount provided we get the proposal into DocuSign and legal approves standard terms. Please leave the onboarding credit in as a placeholder; we'll discuss Optimize access separately with engineering.

Next steps: 
- Send final commercial summary and mutual action plan for signatures (procurement wants DocuSign link by EOD Oct 20).
- We'll run legal review (internal) and circle back with any redlines.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Luke
Head of Platform Engineering, Vertex Retail
